name: Michigan Cubing Club Beta 2015
information:
Due to the relatively small venue, there will be a limit of 60 competitors. If you register and later decide that you can not attend, please let us know so we can make room for other competitors. No walk-in registrations will be allowed.

The base fee is $10.  There is no additional charge for 3x3, but all other events are $2 each.
